debugData.name: Terrain example block
debugData.description: The terrain example's block: generated by the toolkit's rulesTerrain from seeded simplex noise (64 m, 129 vertices a side, −10 to 11 m), its rules laid into its vertex colours on the CPU (scree past 32°, snow above 6 m on slopes under 35°, cliffs past 45°) with the horizon AO in A, a heightfield collider, rocks scattered on its scree.
